unicode61.description: FTS5 default tokenizer; a whole CJK run becomes one token.

trigram.description: Built-in trigram tokenizer; queries under 3 characters match nothing.

trigram_like.description: Trigram, falling back to LIKE scan when the query has <3 chars or FTS finds nothing.

app_bigram.description: App-level overlapping CJK bigrams + unicode61 (the common 'few-line fix'). Single-char queries use a bigram prefix query, so a char at the end of a run is missed.

app_bigram_edge.description: app_bigram plus the first and last char of each CJK run as extra tokens (documents and ranking queries). Isolates the edge-unigram technique fts5-cjk uses at index time.

app_bigram_first.description: app_bigram plus the first char of each CJK run as an extra token (documents and ranking queries). Added after an ablation of app_bigram_edge showed the last char adds cost, not quality.

jieba.description: App-level jieba segmentation: cut_for_search on documents, accurate cut on the query, query tokens combined with AND; unicode61.

jieba_big.description: jieba with its Traditional Chinese dictionary (extra_dict/dict.txt.big, pinned commit and SHA-256); otherwise the same as jieba. Law task only.

icu_segmenter.description: App-level ICU word segmentation (Intl.Segmenter, CJK dictionary) + unicode61; query words combined with AND.

better_trigram.description: streetwriters/sqlite-better-trigram: trigram, with each CJK char as its own token.

fts5_cjk.description: Ray0907/fts5-cjk: overlapping CJK bigrams in the tokenizer; queries go through its documented cjk_query() helper (adds * to single CJK chars).

fts5_cjk_unigram.description: fts5-cjk with its documented 'unigram 1' option: also indexes every single CJK char.
